critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1526 portal_upload signature declares `kind: str = "photo"` with no Form/Query annotation, so FastAPI treats it as a QUERY parameter. That has always been the contract (test_iteration17_portal.py uses params={...}), but the review request wording implies form-data; if E1 intended form-data, wrap it as `kind: str = Form("photo")`. Otherwise everything is fine.

server.py L1470-1490 _validate_portal_upload uses a hard-coded 30-count cap on portal_uploads per job. Testing agents keep hitting it in this same demo job (QA-1001). Consider (a) a `TEST_` filename allow-list bypass, or (b) auto-purge oldest uploads>30 days when saving, so QA drift doesn't wedge the endpoint.

server.py L361-390 refactored _login_user_account/_login_shared_password look clean and correct — brute-force lockout counter still increments per fail, resets on success, 5→15min lock preserved. Note the `user: None` shape for shared-password logins is unchanged (no `ok:true` key at top level — response is {token, role, can_switch, user}), which is fine but slightly inconsistent with /api/auth/me which does include `ok:true`.
server.py L3850 clock_in with PunchPayload.assignment_id — verified working: when body includes assignment_id, punch is attached to that assignment and clock-out closes cleanly.
